author: PackRat 🐀
name: Snake
description: Snake built specifically for the CORSAIR XENEON Edge. Swipe the board, use the large on-screen directional controls, or steer with your keyboard arrow keys while the widget has focus. Chase a local high score and watch the pace climb as the run gets longer. Every official XENEON slot size uses its own board geometry so the game stays readable instead of simply shrinking. No account, no network data, no API key, and no helper app required.
